study type: secondary analysis of a multicenter, prospective observational study
exposure: unknown maternal Group B Streptococcal (GBS) colonization
outcome: ventilator support in the first 24 h
cohort: 4,963 individuals with singleton gestations and planned cesarean delivery ≥37 weeks gestation with cervical dilation ≤3 cm, intact membranes, and no evidence of labor or induction
finding: Unknown GBS status at the time of planned cesarean delivery was not associated with severe neonatal morbidity.
